info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Relationship Management Retrieval API allows users to access detailed customer management information based on specific parameters. This endpoint primarily retrieves valuable insights related to customer relationships, enabling businesses to manage and enhance their interactions. It is typically used by customer service representatives and account managers to obtain essential data about customers. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve customer satisfaction and streamline their management processes.

get.summary: Retrieve customer relationship details by ID.
get.description: Fetches and returns the details of a specific customer relationship using the provided customer ID. This allows clients to obtain all relevant information associated with the customer relationship for processing or review.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding customer relationship management for a specific customer (CUST-100045). It includes data needed to identify the customer and any associated parameters for the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the customer data.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication scheme, which requires a token generated by a server to access protected resources. The token should be passed in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token, following the format: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token must be a valid JSON Web Token (JWT).
